Question: Farmer Fred was the owner of Grapeview Farm, the largest farm in the County of Grapeview. Fred was advised by his gift and estate attorney to begin making annual fractionalized gifts of the property to his children. Fred executed a conveyance instrument, stating the gifts as "one-thirtieth of my ownership interest in Grapeview County, the eastern one tenth of the western corner of the property is hereby given to all my children per capita." This description of the land to be conveyed is

Options: 
A. Sufficient, because it gives a clear description of the fractional gift.
B. Sufficient, because it mentions the name of the county and the property.
C. Sufficient, because it includes the name of the property and a portion of it.
D. Insufficient, because it doesn't state the exact measurements of the land to be given.
E. Insufficient, because the gifts to the children lacked consideration.
F. Insufficient, because it doesn't specify the exact location of the eastern one-tenth.
G. Insufficient, because it is too vague.
H. Sufficient, because the property can be identified.
I. Sufficient, because it satisfies the title of seisin.

Provide the correct letter choice in \boxed{X}, where X is the correct letter choice. Keep the explanation or feedback within 3 sentences.
